compatibility_fixes: Credential-read failure can retry restore and successful recovery clears stale errors.

application_tests: No credentials do not open storage or use the network.
Cached restore opens one repository, preserves pending work and reads no network.
Connection trims credentials and saves only after a verified download.
Rejected credentials preserve the prior account and outbox.
Failed credential saving cannot publish an account switch.
Old-account work stays inaccessible after switching and returns after reconnecting.
Active connection fences other credentials, restore and sample changes.
Disconnect drains a deliberately late response without account resurrection.
Read-only refresh and sample browsing preserve pending work and send nothing.
Acknowledged note upload remains acknowledged if subsequent refresh fails.
Older Mac JSON cache restores offline without changing its source bytes.
Failed credential removal preserves cached account work until a successful retry.
